Definition

Let $H,N$ be Lie groups and let $\theta :H\times N\to N$ be a smooth action by automorphisms. The semidirect product $N\rtimes _\theta H$ is the manifold $N\times H$ with \[ (n,h)(n',h')=\bigl(n\theta _h(n'),hh'\bigr). \]
